buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. OEM IMPORTED PRODUCTS: In case of imported products, OEM or Authorized Seller of OEM should have a registered office in India to provide after sales service support in India. The certificate to this effect should be submitted. 3. Generic Actual delivery (and Installation & Commissioning (if covered in scope of supply)) is to be done at following address Office of the Tahasildar, Sora Sora Sora Near NH 16, Soro Policestation Baleshwar . 4. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Bidders are requested to go through the T&C before applying. 1. Bidders must comply the attached BOQ compliance sheet, sign and seal 2. The Brand Godrej has been selected by Authority to ensure quality and post purchase maintenance. 3. Bidders are requested to attach BID Specific Authorisation, signed by the OEM with phone number and c ontact details, which may be verified. 4. Bidders from Odisha will be given preference. 5. List of service centres available in the area along with contact details of the service centre must be furni shed. 6. Escalation matrix with toll free number to be attached. 7. List of mandatory document: a. Valid GSTIN Certificate. b. PAN of Proprietor or Firm

c. MSME Certificate. d. Declaration of Address of store/organization on Letter head. e. BID Specific Authorisation. f. IT Return for last 3 years to be submitted. g. 3 years Turn Over Certficate duly signed by CA with UDIN number to be submitted . 5. Warranty Warranty period of the supplied products shall be 1 years from the date of final acceptance of goods or after completion of installation, commissioning & testing of goods (if included in the scope of supply), at consignee location. OEM Warranty certificates must be submitted by Successful Bidder at the time of delivery of Goods. The seller should guarantee the rectification of goods in case of any break down during the guarantee period. Seller should have well established Installation, Commissioning, Training, Troubleshooting and Maintenance Service group in INDIA for attending the after sales service. Details of Service Centres near consignee destinations are to be uploaded along with the bid. 6. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Supply Installation Testing and Commissioning of Goods
